note: FNS 822.2 describes how QC reviewers should classify and report variances related to non-citizen status — distinguishing client-caused variances (household misreported citizenship) from agency-caused variances (worker failed to verify or failed to remove known ineligible non-citizens). This is QC audit methodology, not caseworker policy. The underlying substantive policy requirements embedded in this section — that workers must verify non-citizen eligibility status (covered in 'Verification of Immigration Status - SNAP' and SAVE procedures), that ineligible non-citizens must be excluded from the household (covered in 'Nonimmigrants' and 'Nonhousehold Members'), and that income/resources of ineligible members must be handled per certification policy (covered in 'Calculation Rules and Attribution of Income for Mixed Noncitizen Households') — are all addressed in the OLG. The variance classification framework itself (client-caused vs agency-caused, error determination procedures, deficiency exclusion rules) is a QC review construct that has no caseworker equivalent.
